description: Restore a deleted trip owned by the authenticated user, together with the itinerary items that were removed when it was deleted (items deleted separately before that stay deleted). Call without trip_id to list recently deleted trips. Call with trip_id to preview the restore; nothing changes until the user explicitly confirms and you call again with confirmed=true. May re-add the trip to the owner's connected calendars when automatic sync is enabled.

confirmed.description: True only after the user explicitly confirms restoring this trip. Without it the tool only returns a preview.

expected_deleted_at.description: Optional deleted_at value from the preview. The restore is refused if the trip's deletion has changed since then.

trip_id.description: ID of the deleted trip to restore. Omit to list recently deleted trips.

name: trip_restore
title: Restore deleted trip
